posts.title: Local AI - October 2026
posts.description: TL;DR: local inference (running AI models on your own hardware) is still worth it, and cheap to run. Small models are where this is going. But a model running on your own machine isn't automatically a model you can trust - so watch what your agents do (the actions they take), not only what they say . And Flint-40B is a fun, slightly weird model. Details below 👇 Why Run Models At Home? 🏠 Same reaso

posts.title: Nichebench: the harness
posts.description: So, Where Have I Been? 🧭 It's been about 10 months (!) since the last article. Most of that time went into my work at Dropsolid as an AI Product Architect . I've participated in the design, building, and maintaining the AI infrastructure : inference, models, guardrails, tracing, vector stores, and their integrations with Drupal. Quite a few moving parts - plus, some participation in the Drupal AI
